# Access matrix

<!-- Generated by `crates/pm-api/tests/matrix.rs`. Do not edit by hand: run `UPDATE_ACCESS_MATRIX=1 cargo test -p pm-api --test matrix`. -->

What each kind of caller may do on a project server (ADR-0022 step 6, `docs/access.md`). Every REST route and every MCP tool is driven as an **owner**, a **tester** and a **viewer** (signed-in sessions), an **agent token** (ceiling tester, owned by the owner), a **viewer token** and an **anonymous** client. `allow` means authorization let the request through (the request itself may still be refused for bad input: 400, 404, 422); `deny` means 401 or 403, or for a tool the `access denied` error. The sign-in routes are open to anonymous clients on purpose; the account routes decide for themselves (server admins manage accounts; an owner of the project manages members). The test fails when this file and the server disagree.
